scenarios.name: Baseline batch
scenarios.description: Process a deterministic day of orders, captures, shipments, and refunds.
scenarios.invariant: Published totals match the source ledger.

scenarios.name: Duplicate payments
scenarios.description: Deliver every payment twice, with a different arrival time.
scenarios.invariant: Cash totals stay identical to the baseline.

scenarios.name: Late refund
scenarios.description: Receive a prior-day refund three days after it occurred.
scenarios.invariant: Apply the refund to its event date, not its arrival date.

scenarios.name: Conflicting payment
scenarios.description: Reuse a payment event ID with a different amount.
scenarios.invariant: Quarantine the conflicting identity and preserve the last publication.

scenarios.name: Unsupported schema
scenarios.description: Send an unsupported schema version into an otherwise valid batch.
scenarios.invariant: Retain the input and report the unsupported schema version.

scenarios.name: Refund without payment
scenarios.description: Receive a refund whose payment has not arrived.
scenarios.invariant: Mark the relationship pending; do not silently discard the refund.

scenarios.name: Interrupted publication
scenarios.description: Interrupt after output files are complete but before publication.
scenarios.invariant: The previous snapshot stays readable. A retry safely publishes the retained input.

scenarios.name: Negative inventory
scenarios.description: Apply a documented adjustment that exceeds physical stock.
scenarios.invariant: The inventory check prevents publication of invalid stock.
